# io.systemd.CryptEnroll

## Methods

### Enroll

:material-waves: streaming optional · :material-file-swap: passes file descriptors

Enroll a credential into a LUKS2 volume. When enrolling a FIDO2 token that requires user presence, the call must be made with the 'more' flag, so that the server can report when a touch is required via a 'touch' state notification.

```go
func (c *Client) Enroll(ctx context.Context, in EnrollIn) (*EnrollOut, error)
func (c *Client) EnrollMore(ctx context.Context, in EnrollIn) iter.Seq2[*EnrollOut, error]
```

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `node` | `string` | Path to the LUKS2 block device or image to operate on. |
| `mechanism` | `EnrollMechanism` | Which kind of credential to enroll. Only 'password', 'recovery' and 'fido2' may be enrolled via this interface for now; 'pkcs11' and 'tpm2' are rejected with an InvalidParameter error, currently. |
| `unlockPassword` | `?string` | How to unlock the volume for the enrollment operation is inferred from which of the following fields are set: setting unlockPassword unlocks via that password, unlockKeyFile/unlockKeyFileDescriptor via a key file, unlockFido2Device via FIDO2, unlockTpm2Device via TPM2. Exactly one must be set. |
| `unlockKeyFile` | `?string` | Path to a key file to unlock the volume with. |
| `unlockKeyFileDescriptor` | `?int` | Index into the file descriptors passed along with this call, identifying a key file to unlock the volume with. |
| `unlockFido2Device` | `?string` | Path to a FIDO2 device to unlock the volume with. Leave the path empty to automatically discover a suitable device. |
| `unlockTpm2Device` | `?string` | Path to a TPM2 device to unlock the volume with. Leave the path empty to automatically discover a suitable device. |
| `password` | `?string` | The passphrase to enroll, when mechanism is 'password'. Contains key material. |
| `fido2Device` | `?string` | Path to the FIDO2 device to enroll, when mechanism is 'fido2'. Leave empty to automatically discover a suitable device. |
| `fido2Pin` | `?string` | The FIDO2 token PIN to use for enrollment. Contains key material. |
| `fido2WithClientPin` | `?bool` | Whether unlocking the FIDO2 enrollment shall require a client PIN. Defaults to true. |
| `fido2WithUserPresence` | `?bool` | Whether unlocking the FIDO2 enrollment shall require user presence (touch). Defaults to true. |
| `fido2WithUserVerification` | `?bool` | Whether unlocking the FIDO2 enrollment shall require user verification. Defaults to false. |
| `wipeSlots` | `?[]int` | Explicit list of keyslot indexes to wipe after enrolling. |
| `wipeTypes` | `?[]EnrollMechanism` | Wipe all already-enrolled slots of these types after enrolling. |
| `allowInteractiveAuthentication` | `?bool` | Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. |

**Reply**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `slot` | `?int` | The keyslot the new credential was enrolled into. Set on the terminating reply only. |
| `wipedSlots` | `?[]int` | The keyslots wiped as part of this call, if any. |
| `recoveryKey` | `?string` | The generated recovery key, when mechanism is 'recoveryKey'. Contains key material. |
| `state` | `?string` | Progress indicator, only sent on intermediate replies when 'more' was set. Currently the only value is 'touch', signalling that the FIDO2 token is waiting for a touch. Unset on the terminating reply. |

### ListSlots

:material-waves: streaming (requires `more`)

Enumerate the keyslots currently enrolled in a LUKS2 volume, one per reply. Must be called with the 'more' flag.

```go
func (c *Client) ListSlots(ctx context.Context, in ListSlotsIn) iter.Seq2[*ListSlotsOut, error]
```

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `node` | `string` | Path to the LUKS2 block device or image to operate on. |

**Reply**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `slot` | `?int` | A currently enrolled keyslot index. |
| `type` | `?EnrollMechanism` | The type of the keyslot. |

## Types

### EnrollMechanism

The credential types this interface knows about, used both as the enrollment mechanism and as the slot type reported by ListSlots.

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `password` | A regular passphrase |
| `recovery` | A randomly generated recovery key |
| `pkcs11` | A PKCS#11 security token (not enrollable via this interface) |
| `fido2` | A FIDO2 security token |
| `tpm2` | A TPM2 device (not enrollable via this interface) |

## Errors

| Error | Go type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `VolumeUnderForeignManagement` | `VolumeUnderForeignManagementError` | The volume is managed by another subsystem (e.g. systemd-homed) and may not be enrolled into directly. |
| `PasswordRequired` | `PasswordRequiredError` | A password is required to unlock the volume, but none was provided. |
| `PasswordIncorrect` | `PasswordIncorrectError` | The provided password did not unlock the volume. |
| `FidoDeviceNotFound` | `FidoDeviceNotFoundError` | No matching FIDO2 device was found. |
| `FidoActionTimeout` | `FidoActionTimeoutError` | The FIDO2 token was not interacted with in time. |
